rows.title: Inbox icon should be the envelope, not the chat bubble
rows.before: A chat bubble outline in the top right, with no count on it.
rows.after: Our envelope icon with the red unread count badge. The bubble is already used for comments and Join the chat, so it should not also mean inbox.

rows.title: Map lives on the Links list
rows.before: A bare pin icon next to the search bar. Nothing says it opens a map.
rows.after: The pin comes off the Home header. Map is a floating white "Map" pill above the dock on the See all Links list, the Airbnb pattern. Tapping it opens the map, and List view brings you back to the same list. Nothing sits beside the search bar but Ask.

rows.title: Remove the sliders button from Home
rows.before: A sliders button sits next to For You / Near me / Saved on Home, and again in the Feed composer.
rows.after: Take it off Home. For You / Near me / Saved already does that job there. It stays in the Feed composer only, where it opens Tweak your algorithm.

rows.title: Saved comes off the filter row
rows.before: For You / Near me / Saved on every main page, with Saved greyed out when empty.
rows.after: The row is For You / Near me. Saved Links, saved spaces and liked posts each get a page from the profile drawer: Saved and Liked.

rows.title: Profile drawer has seven rows and a Close button
rows.before: Explore, Map, Tickets, Hosting tools, More, Settings, Help, then Close. Explore and Map repeat what Home already does. "More" does not say what is in it. Help uses the AI sparkle icon.
rows.after: Six rows: Tickets, Saved, Liked, Hosting tools, Settings, Help, with Log out under them. Saved and Liked are tucked here the way Instagram does it, instead of being a tab on every page. Tap your name to open your profile. No Explore, no Map, no More, no Close button.

rows.title: Settings repeats the drawer
rows.before: Eleven rows. Tickets and Hosting tools are here and in the drawer. News, Location sharing and Blocked people each get a top-level row. Update my algorithm and JoinLinks+ share one icon. Admin panel shows at the bottom.
rows.after: Six rows, only things you set: Update my algorithm, JoinLinks+, Get verified, Notifications, Account privacy and location, Help. Location sharing and Blocked people live inside Account. Tickets and Hosting tools stay in the drawer. JoinLinks+ gets its own icon. Admin panel only for team accounts. Appearance stays as built.

rows.title: Explore is a second Home
rows.before: A separate page with its own search bar, an Ask JoinLinks AI card, AI suggestion chips, trending searches, then Happening soon and This week rails showing the same two flyers. The sparkle icon appears four times.
rows.after: No Explore page. The search bar on Home opens Search: the field, one row of trending searches, one Ask JoinLinks AI row, then results as you type. The rails stay on Home only.

rows.title: Ask AI has one door
rows.before: Three ways into the same AI on one Explore page: a sparkle in the search bar, an "Ask JoinLinks AI" card, and sparkle chips. The AI screen itself has two stacked headers, outlined filter chips, History and New, a big empty sparkle tile, and suggestions that look like text fields.
rows.after: One door: an orange "Ask" pill with the sparkle, next to the Home search bar where the map pin was. Typing a question in search also offers "Ask JoinLinks AI" with your words. The AI screen is simple: one bar titled JoinLinks AI, "What's the move?", three tappable suggestions, and the same glass composer as chat. Answers come back as real Links, spaces and communities you can tap. No filter chips, no History or New, no Explore page.

rows.title: Tweak your algorithm is one short screen
rows.before: Opens from the sliders button. A long page of separate sections.
rows.after: One question, "What are you into?", with a box to type anything ("More jazz nights in Leimert") that becomes one of your picks, and 14 interest chips to tap. Age, gender and background fold into one optional row, "A little about you", closed by default and never shown on your profile. One Save button with a count. What you want tonight belongs to Ask, not here.

rows.title: Inbox is blank
rows.before: Messages tab with nothing on it.
rows.after: Empty state with one line and a Start a chat button. Activity tab gets the same treatment.

rows.title: Plus always asks "What are you making?"
rows.before: Every tap on plus opens a chooser sheet, then the form also has a three-way bar. Two questions before you can type.
rows.after: No chooser sheet. Plus opens Create a Link on every tab, including Feed and Communities. On the Marketplace tab it opens the same screen with Marketplace selected. Posts start from the "What's the move?" box on Feed.

rows.title: Create bar should say Link / Community / Marketplace
rows.before: The bar reads Link / Community / Venue, so listing a service or a class still shows Venue highlighted at the top.
rows.after: Link / Community / Marketplace on every create screen. It is the only horizontal bar on the screen.

rows.title: Listing on the Marketplace is two steps
rows.before: One form. The type of listing is a row of chips partway down, under a bar that says Venue.
rows.after: Step one is its own screen: "What are you listing?" with three large cards, each with a photo, one line and examples. A venue, a service, a class. Step two is the form for that choice only, titled "List a service", with a back arrow to step one. No type picker inside the form.

rows.title: The listing form changes with the type
rows.before: Guests, Price per hour and Minimum for everything.
rows.after: Venue: guests, price per hour, minimum hours, and space types like Loft or Rooftop. Service: crowd size, price per hour, minimum, and types like DJ or Caterer. Class: spots, price per person, length, and types like Dance or Craft. The title placeholder and the footnote change too. The confirmation says "Your class is listed", not "Your space".

rows.title: Create a Link opens on an empty grey block
rows.before: Tall blank flyer area with a tiny icon. Date and Time are empty.
rows.after: A default flyer, dimmed until you name the Link. Date and time prefilled with the next Saturday at 7 PM.

rows.title: Drafts moves onto the flyer
rows.before: "Drafts 0" sits in the top right of the bar.
rows.after: With three options the bar needs the room, so Drafts is a chip on the bottom left of the flyer, opposite Change flyer. Hide the count when it is zero.

rows.title: Set time, Tentative and TBD
rows.before: Not in the build. This landed after the handoff.
rows.after: A three-way switch above the date. Tentative keeps the date, shows a TENTATIVE chip on cards and the Link page, and gives the host a "Lock in this time" button that tells everyone going. TBD hides the date fields, shows DATE TBD, and swaps RSVP for Notify me so people can follow it.

rows.title: Start a community shows 22 interest chips
rows.before: The full algorithm list.
rows.after: Nine: Outdoors, Game Night, Faith, Fitness, Nightlife, Networking, Food, Art, Music.

rows.title: Add to your story is two steps
rows.before: A sheet with one Photo button, then the photo picker.
rows.after: The sheet opens on the photo grid. Pick one, choose who sees it and what it is about, post.

rows.title: Make a Link from a post, asked once
rows.before: Not in the build. This landed after the handoff.
rows.after: A post that reads like a plan gets one prompt to turn it into a Link, never two, and it always sits at the bottom of the post under the actions. It reads "Make this a Link?". Once five people have commented on your own post, the same bar reads "5 people are in. Make it a Link?". The Link prefills from the post and everyone who commented is told.

rows.title: Two rows of sideways tabs stacked
rows.before: A Map row, large underlined For You / Near me / Saved tabs, then Venues / Services / Classes, then a count and Search & filter. Four rows of controls before any listing.
rows.after: One headline line, one row of tabs (Venues / Services / Classes), then a count and a single Sort & filter button. For You / Near me / Saved do not appear on this page. Map stays on Home.

rows.title: One Sort & filter sheet holds everything
rows.before: Search & filter button, contents not shown.
rows.after: One sheet: search by name, neighborhood or type. Sort by Featured, Closest to you, price or capacity. An "Only show what I saved" toggle. Budget and group size. The button shows a count when anything is on, and Clear resets all of it. Closest to you replaces Near me and asks for location once. Every filter button in the app looks the same: the orange sliders icon on a soft orange pill, on Feed, Marketplace and the Links list.

rows.title: Cards match the marketplace site
rows.before: App-style cards with a business name, an event-type chip and a Book button.
rows.after: The site's card: neighborhood pill on the photo, photo dots, title, one line of facts, "From $125/hr" and Submit an Offer. A heart to save sits on the photo.

rows.title: Titles and chips say the wrong thing
rows.before: Listings show a business name like "Inglewood Event Space" and a chip like "Birthday party" or "Photo shoot".
rows.after: Title is the space type and neighborhood, "Studio in Inglewood", the way the site writes it. The chip is the neighborhood. What it is good for moves to a "Great for" section on the page.

rows.title: Services need real content
rows.before: The Services tab exists but nothing was shown in it.
rows.after: DJ, photographer, caterer, bartender. Facts line reads type, minimum hours and "Comes to you". Caterers price per person. They use the same Submit an Offer flow as venues.

rows.title: Classes need real content
rows.before: The Classes tab exists but nothing was shown in it.
rows.after: Priced per person. Facts line reads the schedule, length and spots. The button is Book a spot, which opens a short sheet of upcoming sessions with spots left. No offer flow.

rows.title: Venue page has no way to book
rows.before: The dock sits at the bottom of the venue page. The only Book button is back on the list.
rows.after: A sticky bar with "From $55/hr · Most hosts reply within hours" and Submit an Offer. The dock hides on this page.

rows.title: Venue page follows the site
rows.before: Photo, name, three fact cards, description, What's included, Cost.
rows.after: Photo with "View all 5 photos". VENUE, SERVICE or CLASS label. Title, neighborhood, square feet, rating or "New listing". Three fact cards: Capacity, Availability, Min. hours. About the space, Great for, What's included, Add-ons, How it works.

rows.title: Add-on costs are his idea and stay
rows.before: A Cost list like "Two strobes with softboxes, $45".
rows.after: Kept on every listing, renamed Add-ons so it does not read as the price of the space.

rows.title: Booking is an offer, like the site
rows.before: A Book button with no flow shown.
rows.after: Submit an Offer sheet: date, how long, time of day, your best offer, what you are throwing, and a choice between ticketing through JoinLinks or a private event. No name or phone, the app already knows. Footnote: "This is just an offer. No payment is collected."

rows.title: After the offer
rows.before: Not shown.
rows.after: "Offer sent!" with the date, hours and amount. If they chose to ticket through JoinLinks, a "Now make it a Link" card prefills the place and date. Sent offers show in a "Your offers" row at the top of Marketplace, and the venue's button becomes View offer.

rows.title: See all should be grouped by date, like the current app
rows.before: The See all list is one unbroken run of flyers with no dates between them.
rows.after: A centered date header above each day, "Friday, Sep 11", with no count, clear space above and below, and a thin line out to each side. Links with no date sit at the end under "Date TBD". The Closest to you list stays ungrouped.

rows.title: Show a real price
rows.before: Cards read "Paid". The Link page reads "20 USD".
rows.after: "From $20" when tickets cost money and "Free" when the cheapest tier is zero. Never "From $0" and never "Paid".

rows.title: "Organizer · 0   Member · 0"
rows.before: Role tabs show for someone who is in no communities.
rows.after: Hidden completely when you are in none, so the page opens on communities to join. The switch only appears once you have both roles. With one, it is a plain "Your communities" label.

rows.title: Missing covers render as grey blocks
rows.before: Community cards and pages show a tall grey gradient when there is no cover.
rows.after: Fall back to the logo on a tinted ground, or the first event flyer.

rows.title: Join failed and the error is hidden
rows.before: "That did not go through. Try again." in small red text under the dock. The Join button went grey. The entry questions never appeared.
rows.after: Join opens the entry questions sheet. Errors show as a toast above the dock, and the button stays tappable so they can retry.

rows.title: Time reads 12:00 AM
rows.before: Imported event shows "Thursday, Nov 12 · 12:00 AM" for a 7 PM show.
rows.after: Import the real start time. If there is none, mark the Link Tentative instead of showing midnight.

rows.title: Description is a wall of text
rows.before: The full imported description runs for screens, with the price bar floating over it.
rows.after: Five lines, then Read more. Line breaks from the source are kept.

rows.title: Missing proof and place
rows.before: No going count, no faces, no map.
rows.after: Faces with "22 going", spots left when there is a capacity, and the small map with "address after RSVP".

rows.title: Get tickets is switched off
rows.before: The button is greyed out with "Live payments are not available in this app".
rows.after: Get tickets opens checkout: tiers, coupon, fee line, total, then the ticket in your wallet. If payments have to stay off in this build, say so on the page and say where to buy instead of showing a dead button.

rows.title: Share sheet is half empty
rows.before: "Send to" shows "Nothing here yet" across half the sheet.
rows.after: Hide Send to until there is someone to send to.
